task.description:
WF-03 Step 2 Rework 1 — Fix CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR FAIL for GH-821.

The validator found that src/design/WF03-GH821-fix-design.md does not address the divergence between:
- GH-821 AC#1: 'Replace the hardcoded UUID in the PAR-02 fixture with a per-test-generated UUID'
- Applied fix (bc9af23f): UUID changed to all-zeros sentinel 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000

Add an explicit paragraph to src/design/WF03-GH821-fix-design.md explaining:
1. AC#1 specified 'per-test-generated UUID' but the all-zeros sentinel was chosen instead
2. Why: platform-level tests (setting api_tenant_context with no tenant) must use the canonical no-tenant sentinel, not a random UUID, because the sentinel has special meaning in the engine
3. How this satisfies T010 intent: lint_test_isolation.py's ALL_ZEROS_UUID exemption exists precisely because all-zeros is a well-known constant (not a secret test state), and the test correctly documents its intent by using the sentinel
4. GH-821 AC#1 is satisfied in spirit: the fixture no longer uses a UUID that encodes test-specific state; the all-zeros sentinel is not a 'hardcoded test UUID' but a protocol constant

Do NOT write Zig code in the design file.
acceptance_criteria: src/design/WF03-GH821-fix-design.md contains an explicit AC#1 divergence paragraph
The paragraph explains why all-zeros sentinel satisfies T010 intent
No Zig/SQL/TS code in the design file

result.summary: Added AC#1 divergence section to src/design/WF03-GH821-fix-design.md. Explains why all-zeros sentinel is the correct protocol constant for a platform-level no-tenant fixture call, why a random per-test UUID would be semantically wrong, how the ALL_ZEROS_UUID linter exemption satisfies T010 intent, and why GH-821 AC#1 is fully satisfied.
